name: bada-studio
description: BADA Studio — a sound & video editing studio that also composes. Import audio of any extension (decoded by content) and video, cut and arrange clips on a timeline, let the rule-based counterpoint engine write four voices over an editable orchestral chord progression of five or more lines, play with synthesized orchestra / piano / sampler (your own sounds), and export WAV, MIDI, video (MP4/WebM), score.json and projects. Self-contained HTML app, zero dependencies, fully offline.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
